scope: Read-only host replay and bounded next-sample adaptation plan; no guest commands or new generic framework

risks: Fixed address admission range could omit future slid cache frames. Select PCs through validated cache mappings or validated runtime Binary Images intervals instead.

symbolize-cache.cpp uses nearest image and symbol, not verified symbol sizes. Do not interpret nearest-symbol result as exact function ownership past boundaries; validate image range and retain offset.

Old script checks standalone backboardd UUID but does not check standalone SpringBoard UUID. A future adaptation should require explicit original executable for the requested target and LC_UUID match, or leave standalone frames unknown.
Sparse patch check covers sampled4-byte instructions only, not whole functions, dependencies or runtime memory.
Original output warns missing matching kernel/kext symbol owners; kernel frames remain unresolved.
Do not reuse49 slide0x14514000 or a prior targetPID/boot UUID.
reconstruction_invocation: Require transport_complete and original tool duration/steps/target identity; inspect tool errors before symbolication. Preserve incomplete output as incomplete.
next_adaptation_contract: Take explicit sample output, original cache, original target executable, original sparse patch plan, symbolizer binary and new output directory.
Use sample-result provenance/request for boot and target; parse exactly one Shared Cache header from this sample. Validate cache UUID and slid base against cache mappings plus sample slide.
Validate Binary Images UUID/runtime base for every mapped image. Use these actual ranges to choose frame addresses; preserve unmapped and standalone/unknown frames verbatim.
Retain raw symbolizer stdout/stderr, derived text, per-frame mappings/unknown reason, hashes and source identities. Never overwrite raw sample or earlier49 evidence.
Compare healthy49 and future stalled sample by named thread and mapped call path, allowing different addresses/slides/PIDs. A waiting stack alone is not causal proof.
decision: No new generalized helper committed yet: exact old replay verified; bounded adaptation can be made when an actual next sample provides format/target evidence, avoiding silently broadening old range assumptions.
